to: DrSwarm project owner via the HN-listed application channel
subject: Five-minute LLM integration demo for DrSwarm — Founding Engineer (Full-Stack)
body:
Hello DrSwarm team,

Saw your Founding Engineer (Full-Stack) post in the July 2026 HN Who's Hiring thread — you're asking for LLM integration + Python + TypeScript + React on AWS in one seat, which reads less like a job spec than an admission that five moving parts have to stop lying to each other before the product ships. That's the wedge for a bounded paid pilot rather than an FTE conversation: I take one seam where an LLM call feeds typed code that touches AWS, ship a small deterministic slice with an exportable JSON receipt of what actually ran, and add a refused-input path so a bad prompt can't quietly leak downstream.

Proposed first milestone (paid, fixed-scope, replaces no headcount):
1. Reproduce one representative LLM->typed-code seam with synthetic inputs.
2. Add the validation/retry boundary and the exportable receipt before scope expands.
3. Hand over the code, a short runbook, and one acceptance check DrSwarm can re-run.

Proof: https://hfo-games.pages.dev/ ships 21 live browser games (short-loop delivery under real deadlines), and https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133 exposes the append-only receipts and operator-gated effect model behind that cadence. I am pitching integration labor on a bounded scope — the Founding Engineer FTE ask is not what I'm answering.

If that seam is real for DrSwarm, book a 15-minute look at the attached demo: {{OPERATOR_BOOKING_LINK}}. If not, no follow-up.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming
